page.overview:
What is Mt. Kintoki?

Mt. Kintoki is a mountain on an island somewhere in the Grand Line. It is Sentomaru's place of origin.

Little of Mt. Kintoki has been shown, but it appears to be covered in a large forest. A village is located very close to Mt. Kintoki, enough so that they are sometimes plagued by animals leaving the forest.

The only known citizen of Mt. Kintoki was Sentomaru, when he was a child.

As a young child, Sentomaru was banished by the village near Mt. Kintoki, and took up residence on the mountain. Using his sumo abilities, he began living on the mountain, eventually becoming the de facto master of the mountain.
